import csv

with open('{{in_csv}}', newline='') as f, open('{{out_csv}}', 'w', newline='') as out:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    writer = csv.DictWriter(out, fieldnames=reader.fieldnames)
    writer.writeheader()
    kept = 0
    for row in reader:
        if row.get('{{filter_col}}', '').strip():
            writer.writerow(row); kept += 1
print(f'kept {kept} rows')
